_about: Form I-730, Refugee/Asylee Relative Petition (src/i730.py): for each spouse or unmarried child under 21, a G-28 and an I-730 (8 CFR 208.21(c)-(d), 207.7(d): a separate petition for each); then the evidence the I-730 page and Instructions ask for (uscis.gov/i-730, updated 09/09/2026): proof of the client's asylee or refugee status, a photo of each relative, the relationship (marriage certificate and earlier marriages ended, each child's birth certificate, adoption or stepchild records), a relative in the U.S.: their I-94. Mailed to USCIS, Attn: I-730, P.O. Box 20018, Phoenix. No fee (Form G-1055 10/01/26). DRAFT: the attorney approves titles and order.
title: Relative petition for a spouse or child (I-730)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: A passport-style photograph (or a recent clear photo) of each relative: USCIS may send a request for evidence without it (uscis.gov/i-730).

The proof of each relationship: the marriage certificate and the end of any earlier marriage; each child's birth certificate naming the client (and, for a father, the marriage certificate or legitimation); a stepchild's or adopted child's records; certified English translations (I-730 Instructions).

exhibits.title: Proof of the petitioner's asylee or refugee status: the asylum approval or the immigration judge's order, the I-94, the work permit
Proof of the relationship: marriage certificate, documents ending earlier marriages, birth certificates, with certified English translations
